tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Window background and gaps between panels. Feathers palette GRAY_0, token feathers.window.bg.

tokens.name: surface-pane
tokens.usage: Panel body. Feathers palette GRAY_1 (pane background).

tokens.name: surface-item
tokens.usage: Fields, rows on hover, panel headers. Feathers palette GRAY_2 (item background).

tokens.name: surface-item-active
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest, pressed rows. Feathers palette GRAY_3; feathers.button.bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Viewport letterbox and wells behind a progress bar. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The layer between the window and a dialog: the window shows through, dimmed, and takes no input. surface-sunken at 72 % alpha. Arc addition.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and around fields. Feathers palette WARM_GRAY_1.

tokens.name: text-main
tokens.usage: Labels and values on any surface token. Feathers LIGHT_GRAY_1; feathers.text.main.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, units, disabled text. Feathers LIGHT_GRAY_2; feathers.text.dim. About 3.8:1 on surface-pane: below 4.5:1, so never the only carrier of needed information.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent and on selection. Feathers WHITE (button label text).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button, checked controls, slider fill. Feathers ACCENT (#206EC9); feathers.button.primary.bg.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text or icons on surfaces, where accent itself is too dark to read. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Background of the selected row or tile. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px keyboard focus outline. Feathers ACCENT at 50 % alpha; feathers.focus.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X marker on vector fields. Feathers palette X_AXIS.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y marker on vector fields. Feathers palette Y_AXIS.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z marker on vector fields. Feathers palette Z_AXIS.

tokens.name: gizmo-x
tokens.usage: X handle of the viewport transform gizmo. Engine constant COLOR_X in bevy_gizmos transform_gizmo.rs.

tokens.name: gizmo-y
tokens.usage: Y handle of the transform gizmo. Engine constant COLOR_Y.

tokens.name: gizmo-z
tokens.usage: Z handle of the transform gizmo. Engine constant COLOR_Z.

tokens.name: signal-play
tokens.usage: Play mode is running: status bar segment, viewport frame. Always with the word or an icon. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: Unsaved changes, a level that needs cooking, recoverable warnings. Always with text. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: signal-error
tokens.usage: Failed load, save or cook; invalid field. Always with text. Arc addition, draft.

styles.name: compact
styles.usage: Tree rows and property labels. Feathers COMPACT_FONT.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Panel headers, status bar. Feathers SMALL_FONT.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Units and axis letters. Feathers EXTRA_SMALL_FONT.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Numeric field values, paths, hashes. Feathers ships Fira Mono Medium.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a field and its axis marker.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside fields and rows; gap between toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons; indent step of half a tree level.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of panel bodies; gap between property rows and groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: One tree indent level; padding of notices and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between dialog sections.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, rows, panel corners. The radius Feathers uses at the pin for buttons, number inputs and panes.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text inputs and dialogs. Feathers uses 6 px on its text input.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle switch track, half its 18 px height.

size.note: Fixed control sizes, from Feathers constants.rs unless marked.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Tree rows, property rows, buttons. Feathers ROW_HEIGHT.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Panel headers and the tab strip. Feathers HEADER_HEIGHT.

tokens.name: check-size
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio. Feathers CHECKBOX_SIZE, RADIO_SIZE.

tokens.name: toggle-width
tokens.usage: Toggle switch track. Feathers TOGGLE_WIDTH; height is check-size.

tokens.name: tool-size
tokens.usage: Square tool buttons in the toolbar. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: Status bar at the window bottom. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: tile-size
tokens.usage: Asset browser tile. Arc addition, draft.

tokens.name: hierarchy-width
tokens.usage: Width of the hierarchy panel. Arc addition.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Width of the inspector panel. Arc addition.

tokens.name: viewport-min-width
tokens.usage: The 3D view is never narrower than this: side panels collapse first on a narrow window. Arc addition.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of one toolbar row. Arc addition.

tokens.name: toolbar-fold-width
tokens.usage: In a window narrower than this the toolbar's tools and panel switches fold into menus, so that it keeps one row. Arc addition.

tokens.name: menu-width
tokens.usage: The least width of a menu; rows with long captions and keys make it wider. Arc addition.
